fields.label: Project reference
fields.description: Exact project identity containing the current work item.

fields.label: Work-item action
fields.description: Private exact action text that must resolve once to an unchecked governed project work item.

fields.label: Execution disposition
fields.description: Explicit operator judgment: create a tracked Task or complete a coordination-only item in place. Automation never infers this boundary.

fields.label: Assignee
fields.description: Optional authenticated-self assignment for tracked execution; arbitrary person identifiers are not accepted.
